hadith:
Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage - Narrated Ibn `Abbas:

A woman from the tribe of Juhaina came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "My mother had vowed to perform Hajj but she died before performing it. May I perform Hajj on my mother's behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Perform Hajj on her behalf. Had there been a debt on your mother, would you have paid it or not? So, pay Allah's debt as He has more right to be paid."
message: When we turn away from Allah's guidance and His Messenger's judgment, we distance ourselves from the path of righteousness; instead, we should recognize that Allah, Al-Qaabid, controls all provisions and sustenance, reminding us to trust in His wisdom even when we face difficulties. Just as the woman in the hadith understood that paying debts to Allah is our greatest obligation, we too must prioritize fulfilling our duties to Him and seeking His judgment in our affairs with sincerity and obedience.
name:
Al Qaabid - الْقَابِضُ - The Constrictor

The name Al Qaabid reflects Allah's attribute of controlling provision and restricting the means of sustenance as He wills. It signifies that Allah has the authority to grant or withhold bounty and that everything is under His control. This name reminds believers of the importance of gratitude and reliance on Allah, as well as the transient nature of worldly possessions.
verse:
An-Nur - The Light - 24:48

And as soon as they are called to Allah and His Messenger so he may judge between them, a group of them turns away.
